question: Does a liquidity-aware causal geometry gate remove mislabeled or obstructed ATT1 shorts while preserving economically useful descending-resistance entries?
motivation: The 2026-08-02 LTCUSDT live entry was accepted by the champion as a trendline touch although the fitted resistance was rising, weak, not reached, roughly 1 ATR above entry, and a nearer horizontal liquidity structure better explained the reaction.

required_evidence: signal candle reaches the projected line zone
entry remains close to the rejection
at least 0.80R room before equal-low or horizontal support
horizontal-resistance reactions are attributed to their own family

decision_rule: The same-window preflight can reject the challenger but cannot promote it. Promotion requires an untouched OOS pass, adequate sample size, no single-symbol dependence, and a stable neighborhood rather than one threshold island.
